title: Membership in a property index set
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $P$ be a property of Boolean strings of length $n$, and let $w$ be such a string. The index assigned to $w$ belongs to the set of indices for strings satisfying $P$ if and only if $P(w)$ holds.
hypotheses_covered: $P$ is a property of Boolean strings of length $n$
$w$ is a Boolean string of length $n$
